Detail of Bartholomew map with arrows showing
  the National Maternity Hospital where the young men started
  (blue), Burke's pub which they have just left (red), Mount
  Street where the fire engine is heard (orange), and Denzille
  Lane (green). Source: Pierce, James Joyce's Ireland.
